financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of ADSs and pre-funded warrants; gross proceeds used because net was not given. Closing was expected on or about 2023-09-22, and the excerpt does not confirm it closed.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: pre-funded warrants (the “Pre-Funded Warrants”) to purchase up to 48,387 ADSs at a purchase price per Pre-Funded Warrant of $3.10, for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $2 million.

warrants.quote: The Pre-Funded Warrants will be immediately exercisable at an exercise price of $0.20 per ADS and will not expire until exercised in full.
